altTitles.en: I've Been Convicted for the Fifth Time… Will There Ever Be an End to This

description.en:
“So, I’m going to die again… isn’t that right?”

Every time, she is accused of a crime she didn’t commit, stripped of her engagement, imprisoned, and ultimately poisoned to death in her cell. This has already happened five times.

After all those cycles of life and death repeating the same way, she no longer has the energy to fight back. She no longer cares about her fate… But this time, before her usual end arrives, the strongest sorcerer on the continent suddenly appears to break this endless loop!

However, his rescue doesn’t come without a price. When she asks him why he interfered, he smiles confidently and says:

“I only want one thing in return… the right to flirt with you.”

From endless convictions to an unexpected romance—will this new life be any different from the ones before? Or does fate still have surprises in store for her?

A romantic tale filled with mystery, magic, and a destiny that refuses to leave the heroine in peace!
